observations: Read actual installed save_on_cpu and saved_tensors_hooks source/version before implementing direct delegation
Candidate pack input, CPU payload and unpack output shape/dtype/layout/stride/storage_offset/device; scalar sequence IDs only
Symmetric forward values and incoming production backward gradients at original stages/shared_global return boundary
All existing output/head/281-gradient/state/buffer/RNG/BN/hook outcomes persisted before the final fixed assertion
instrumentation_limits: Delegate original built-in pack/unpack exactly once; no extra copies, contiguous, dtype changes or new streams
Do not retain original saved GPU tensor references merely to log metadata
No callback cpu/item/global synchronization; compare retained boundary gradients after production backward
No whole-DAG profiler, new loss, optimizer step, full campaign, fallback or compatibility path
If observation changes behavior or failure does not recur, report inconclusive and stop; do not replace v4 failure with a pass
decision_rules: Observed saved stride/layout difference plus equal boundary forward and gradients supports prioritizing saved representation, without proving sole cause
Different boundary forward requires locating hidden forward divergence first
Equal boundary forward but different boundary gradients means the difference is already present at the backbone backward input; a pack-only fix is not established
No layout difference, no recurrence, or insufficient evidence means unresolved; terminate the diagnostic without automatic follow-on memory candidates
